scope: All 24 residual standalone znovo recurrence adverbs, all in the base papers.
choice: Normalize every site to the already controlling official type-1 adverb ponovno.
motivation: Every site means again/once more. This extends EDIT-0008, which already normalized the same semantic class from znovu to ponovno.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining znovo leaves a zero-headword surface.
Reverting to znovu would undo EDIT-0008.
Iznova would create an unmotivated synonym beside the declared house form.

evidence.official_dictionary: isv_words_list.csv SHA-256 072DE8E512EB386780D199FBD6F0ACF2639D3096EA920F1AF2D0AFCC5535E842: ponovno type1 again/once more with W/S/E coverage; no znovo headword.
evidence.semantic_review: All 24 sites are repeated notation, substitution, application, assumption, or an object/property occurring again; no protected literal or anew-from-scratch sense.
evidence.baseline_correction: Direct scan distinguishes 195 lowercase and six capitalized pre-existing targets; post totals are 219 lowercase plus six capitalized, 225 overall.

validation.postcondition: znovo/znovu variants zero and target totals exact
validation.structure: TeX controls, labels/refs/cites, braces, math delimiters and line counts invariant
validation.reproducibility: frozen successor hashes reproduced before atomic apply
